classification.rationale: Connecting rods of diesel engines for heavy trucks are parts of 8408 engines, in 8409.99. Class 8 trucks are 8701.2x or 8704 vehicles, so the 'installed in vehicles' line .91 applies, with connecting rods at suffix .10. I83991 (diesel engine part, 8409.99.9290) supports the 8409.99 heading for diesel engine parts but is a marine elbow and not a connecting rod.
